paths.name: Productized creative-workflow services
paths.offer: Repeatable fixed-scope implementation plus training in existing approved tools
paths.billing_basis: one-time project revenue; not current price or MRR
paths.acquisition: Permissioned existing relationships, individually qualified studio conversations, referrals; no paid media initially
paths.readiness: Research-ready, not sales/delivery-qualified; $500 diagnostic/$2500 pilot hypotheses
risks: Price increase from pilot requires proven value, not assumed repricing
paths.time_to_signal: 48 active-work hours preparation, 7 calendar days response window; 2–4 weeks pilot estimate not promise
paths.next_validation: 5 completed qualified interviews, 2 proposal requests, then 1 approved paid pilot with measured labor

paths.name: Narrow ScenePilot Pro outcome; suite expansion only after proof
paths.customer: Independent video creators delivering repeat short-form edits
paths.offer: Qualified native/pro workflow with concrete advantage; free Lite unchanged
paths.acquisition: Real import-to-export demos, niche creator education, permissioned beta users and referrals
paths.readiness: Public Lite alpha; full golden workflow and paid licensing not qualified
risks: No recurring revenue from one-time sales
paths.time_to_signal: 48 active-work hours prototype/offer comprehension preparation after a reliable sample; paid validation only after release gates
paths.next_validation: Reuse CORE-SP-WORKFLOW-001/W03/M05 to test one honest outcome with 5 qualified creators

paths.name: Institutional creative-workflow onboarding
paths.customer: Small design/video schools and independent creative teams
paths.offer: Curriculum, onboarding, compatible templates and limited support; institutional licensing only where rights allow
paths.readiness: Learning assets exist; institutional procurement, privacy, accessibility, uptime and support capacity unqualified
paths.time_to_signal: 48 active-work hours interview prep, 2–6 weeks buyer response/procurement discovery estimate
paths.next_validation: 3 educator interviews and 1 scoped workshop request before any school feature development

capacity_note: 100 service projects at 40 hours each require 4000 delivery hours, plus sales/support; 200 education accounts at 10 hours/year require 2000 hours. Software acquisition at an illustrative 2% visitor-to-purchase requires 251300 qualified visits for 5026 sales; 2% is NOT observed conversion. Fees/refunds/tax/cost are additional.
